'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Spain]]
**Following an order from the [[National Court of Spain|National Court]] of [[Spain]], the ruling [[PSOE]] party's headquarters are raided by the [[Civil Guard (Spain)|Civil Guard]]. The party’s manager, two former senior officials, and a businessman are charged as part of an investigation into possible [[political corruption|illegal funding]] of a possible operation to target the [[General Commissariat of Judiciary Police|judicial police]], judges, and prosecutors investigating corruption cases involving the party itself. [https://www.huffingtonpost.es/politica/la-uco-entra-sede-psoe-ferraz-registro-f202605.html (''HuffPost'' <small>in Spanish</small>)] [https://www.politico.eu/article/pedro-sanchez-spain-police-raid-headquarters-of-pm-socialist-party/ (''Politico'')]
*[[Scam centers in Cambodia]]
**A [[Cambodia]]n [[Judiciary of Cambodia|court]] sentences six [[China|Chinese]] nationals to [[life imprisonment]] for kidnapping, torturing, and murdering a [[South Korea]]n student linked to a transnational fraud network operating in Cambodia. [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3355087/cambodia-jails-6-chinese-men-south-korean-students-torture-and-murder (AFP via ''South China Morning Post'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/cambodia-sentences-six-murder-south-korean-student-linked-scam-centre-2026-05-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Trial of Jeffrey Donaldson]]
**The trial of former [[Northern Ireland|Northern Irish]] [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|MP]] [[Jeffrey Donaldson]] for [[Sexual offences in the United Kingdom|sexual offences]] begins at the [[Newry]] [[Courts of Northern Ireland#Crown_Court|Crown Court]]. Two women allege Donaldson [[Child sexual abuse in the United Kingdom|abused them as children]]. His wife Eleanor is facing a separate [[trial of the facts]] because she has been found to be unfit to stand trial because of mental health issues. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/trial-northern-irelands-donaldson-alleged-sex-offences-begins-2026-05-27/ (Reuters)] [https://www.rte.ie/news/courts/2026/0527/1575433-jeffrey-donaldson-court/ (RTÉ)]
